Goal one is reconciliation by honoring indigenous peoples histories language and culture and actions for this goal including incorporating indigenous symbols to reflect cultural representation.

Implementing indigenous placekeeping elements and storytelling establishing an ongoing engagement process with elders and knowledge keepers for projects and initiatives and prioritizing the sale of city own land to first nation and indigenous organizations.

Goal two focuses on enhancing and celebrating the lands heritage history and culture and this creates opportunities for additional public art throughout the city center in district.
The preservation and restoration of historic artifacts for display and education.
Reenforcing common design elements across downtown districts and improving comfort and infrastructure for activation during winter months.
Next slide please.
Goal three focuses on architectural and public realm design that reflects the city's confidence in the public realm laying groundwork for increased private investment.

Actions include strengthening the visual character of downtown through distinctive street types trading a new zoning district for the entertainment district to ensure building design that integrates with the surrounding public realm and amending current downtown zoning districts to promote a more diverse mix of housing options.
Next slide please.
Goal four is reliable and efficient transportation options that focuses on improving connectivity and accessibility for all modes of travel.
This includes enhancing the pedestrian network addressing accessibility barriers and expanding bicycle parking options.
Streets well be designed to support and maximize the benefits of the link network as well as local transit routing.
The plan also outlines actions for managing parking resources more effectively, including exploring parking management systems and new technologies to optimize parking availability.

The plan emphasizes increasing density in the downtown, aligning with the city's growth plan of directing 25% of new development into the downtown.

Next slide please.
Goal six focuses on trading resilient spaces and protecting the environment for future generations.
This includes water conservation practices rainwater capture and planting resilient native species and new parks and open spaces.
The actions also call for establishing a tree maintenance and planting service level that is specific to downtown to protect maintain and grow the tree canopy.
Additionally it includes reviewing underutilized green spaces such as the area on the north side of city hall for opportunities that could increase activation and community use.
Next slide please.
Goal seven aims to strengthen the downtown economy by reviewing and updating the city's policy framework.
This includes strengthening the downtown as the premier location for office development through targeted policy amendments.
Revising the mobile food truck policy to encourage greater street activation and remaining responsive to opportunities for establishing a grocery store downtown.
